name: deployment-readiness

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      expected_sha:
        description: Exact Git SHA to certify
        required: true
        type: string
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  certify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.expected_sha || github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24.x
      - run: test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${{ inputs.expected_sha || github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}"
      - run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm run release:check
        env: &phase7_env
          NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL: https://certification.invalid
          NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: https://example.supabase.co
          NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: test
          NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY: test
          NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_EMAIL: support@ci.provenance-cleaner.test
          SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY: test
          STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: sk_test_ci_placeholder
          STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: whsec_ci_placeholder
          TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY: test
          RATE_LIMIT_HASH_SALT: test-test-test-test-test-test
          PROMO_FINGERPRINT_SECRET: ci-only-placeholder-secret-32-characters-minimum
          CRON_SECRET: test-test-test-test-test-test
          STRIPE_PRICE_STARTER: price_test
          STRIPE_PRICE_PLUS: price_test
          STRIPE_PRICE_PRO: price_test
          STRIPE_SUBSCRIPTION_PRICE_PLUS: price_test_subscription_plus
          STRIPE_SUBSCRIPTION_PRICE_PRO: price_test_subscription_pro
          STRIPE_SUBSCRIPTION_PRICE_STUDIO: price_test_subscription_studio
          ADMIN_OWNER_USER_ID: 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: npm run test:e2e
      - run: npm run predeploy
        env: *phase7_env
      - name: Verify final migrations contain no destructive table DDL
        run: '! rg -n "^\s*(drop table|truncate|delete from)" supabase/migrations/20260903144643_phase7_admin_finops_subscriptions.sql supabase/migrations/20260907054500_phase8_review_hardening.sql supabase/migrations/20260907055200_phase8_readiness.sql supabase/migrations/20260909043500_phase8_finops_revenue.sql'
